Photograph: Mike Egerton/PA Sarah Rendell Thu 29 Oct 2026 17.25 EDT First published on Thu 29 Oct 2026 15.00 EDT Share Key events 20m ago Back underway: Man City 0-0 Paris Saint-Germain 
 35m ago Half-time: Man City 0-0 Paris Saint-Germain 
 1h ago Kick-off! 
 2h ago Team news 
 2h ago Preamble 
 now 17.25 EDT 66 min : City are putting more pace into their game but Groenen does well to marshal the ball to Peda. The former Manchester United player looks uncomfortable afterwards, grabbing her face but she is okay to continue. PSG makes their first change with Morissaint off for Kaninga.
 Share 2m ago 17.23 EDT 64 min : Charles makes an immediate impact with a cross popped into the box but the chance goes begging.
 Share 3m ago 17.21 EDT 62 min : The longer this match goes on, the more it feels like neither side are going to score. Or I will be very wrong and the game will open up into a goal fest. City makes three subs with Clinton, Casparji and Knaak for Beney, Charles and Fowler.
 Share 5m ago 17.19 EDT 60 min : Karchaoui makes a great run but she is fouled by Greenwood, who receives a yellow card for the foul. The set piece is in a good spot and Karchaoui takes it. It’s lifted over the wall but it’s just over the top corner.
 Share 7m ago 17.17 EDT 58 min : Hemp and Greenwood connect beautifully down the left and Hemp gets a perfectly timed cross in but Samoura again defends well as Fujino tried to get a shot on target but failed.
 Share 9m ago 17.15 EDT 56 min : The pace of this game hasn’t slowed as such but it feels a bit more scrappy. Some bright moments for both teams but nothing is sticking.
 Share 11m ago 17.13 EDT 54 min : End-to-end football ensues but fans are yet to see a meaninful chance.
 Share 13m ago 17.11 EDT 52 min : The corner ball comes in but Shaw is shoved to the floor, nothing is given. Knaak makes contact with the ball but her header is wide.
 Share 14m ago 17.11 EDT 51 min : Shaw was so close to closing down Samoura in the box but PSG somehow manage to organise a scramble defence, it ends with City being awarded another corner.
 Share 16m ago 17.09 EDT 50 min : Here come City again but Osteras deflects the ball out of play for a corner. The delivery from Casparji is short but it eventually comes in and Shaw sees it out for a goal kick.
 Share 18m ago 17.07 EDT 48 min : This half is very much the same story as the first: City in control but PSG growing.
 Share 19m ago 17.06 EDT 46 min : There are no changes for either side at half-time. City look to get this half off to a quick start with Fujino having a chance which goes wide.
 Share 20m ago 17.05 EDT Back underway: Man City 0-0 Paris Saint-Germain
 Will we see a winner in this second half? All to come.
 Share 31m ago 16.54 EDT In the other 8pm GMT kick-off, Barcelona are beating Køge 2-0.
 Share 35m ago 16.49 EDT Half-time: Man City 0-0 Paris Saint-Germain
 Well, City will be wondering how they didn’t score in the opening 25 minutes. Hemp has been incredible but they are yet to find a way through. PSG are growing into this and they will look to break the deadlock in the second 45.
 Share 35m ago 16.49 EDT 45 + 4 min : Carmona gives away a corner late on in the first half and it’s popped in. It’s headed goalward but Peda saves.
 Share 36m ago 16.48 EDT 45 + 3 min : There is a slight delay to half-time as Samoura is receiving some treatment for a stray elbow. She looks okay to continue.
 Share 38m ago 16.46 EDT 45 + 1 min : There will be one minute added.
 Share 40m ago 16.44 EDT 44 min : Greenwood takes the corner and the deliver, again, is very good but no one is found in the box and it’s out for a goal kick.
 Share 41m ago 16.44 EDT 43 min : Hemp makes a great run as she tries to spark something towards the end of this half, she attempts a cross but Samoura blocks it for a corner.
 Share 43m ago 16.42 EDT 42 min : A lot of the game now being played in the midfield, if City don’t find a break through they will be frustrated at half-time.
 Share 45m ago 16.40 EDT 40 min : Echegini has been desperate to have a chance and that’s clear when it comes, she launches it goalward but it is very wide of target.
 Share 46m ago 16.39 EDT 39 min : While PSG are having more joy with the ball, their attack feels rushed and forced. That may be down to City’s good defence but they just need more patience in their game right now.
 Share 47m ago 16.37 EDT 37 min : Now it is City’s time to defend and they do a good job, containing them in the midfield for large periods. It eventually comes to Groenen who takes a shot but it’s wide.
 Share 49m ago 16.35 EDT 35 min : The aim for City is clear, get the ball to Shaw in the box. A long range pass almost finds the striker who stretches to try and reach it but Samoura does expertly well to see it out for a corner. The delivery from Greenwood is good but PSG defends well.
 Share 52m ago 16.33 EDT 33 min : The game has become a bit more loose now, City are still having the lionshare of the ball but their chances have slowed with PSG feeling a little more confident.
 View image in fullscreen Yui Hasegawa battles for the ball with Lea Morissaint. Photograph: Darren Staples/AFP/Getty Images Share Updated at  16.42 EDT 53m ago 16.31 EDT 31 min : We have Tom Garry in Manchester tonight and he has sent this through from the Joie Stadium:
 double quotation mark Birmingham City’s former PSG winger Océane Hurtré is in the stands watching some of her former team-mates tonight. The France international played in the League Cup last night, in a 1-1 draw at Aston Villa. She’s chatting to some of the PSG staff as she takes in the action in a relatively quiet stand. The overall turnout doesn’t look great tonight, to be honest, and the atmosphere is low key.
 Share 1h ago 16.29 EDT 29 min : Peda is saved by her backline and the keeper has a loose pass but the defenders mop up the space to make it impossible for City to create a chance.
 Share 1h ago 16.27 EDT 27 min : City half appeal for a penalty as Shaw hits the floor in the box and nothing is given. While the hosts still have a firm grip on this encounter but PSG are starting to get a bit more possession. They do well with it too with Morissaint getting a shot away which is just wide.
 Share 1h ago 16.25 EDT 25 min : Carmona handballs as PSG tried to put some attacking phases together and City are able to clear.
 Share 1h ago 16.23 EDT 23 min : Samoura comes good again for PSG as Hemp pops in another ball into the box, the England international has been absolutely brilliant in the opening stages.
 Share 1h ago 16.21 EDT 21 min : Yamashita comes out of the goal to contain a long pass from Feller, the panicked pass showing how rushed the visitors are in attack. Whereas City are being quite patient in their build-up.
 Share 1h ago 16.19 EDT 19 min : City are in control of this match, all they are lacking is a difference on the scoreboard so far. So many nice exhanges between players with Hemp the latest putting a ball wide but this pressure will surely bring a goal if they keep it up.
 Share 1h ago 16.17 EDT 17 min : City win a corner and Casparji is the taker. She whips it in, Peda punches away but City keeps the pressure on. However, PSG smother the chance and the threat is over.
 Share 1h ago 16.15 EDT 15 min : Holy moly that would have been a screamer if Shaw had slotted that in. A lovely chipped pass from Hemp finds her teammates who takes a one-touch finish but it goes wide. Best chance of the evening so far.
 Share 1h ago 16.14 EDT 14 min : Feller does very well up against Rose, winning the ball and dribbling it up the pitch. She gets in a shooting position but Yamashita saves easily.
 Share 1h ago 16.12 EDT 12 min : PSG have their first shot with Karchaoui taking a quick punt but it’s way wide, the French club throwing their first punch of the evening though. City, meanwhile, hit back immediately with Hemp trying to lay it off to Shaw but Samoura clears really well.
 View image in fullscreen Sakina Karchaoui has an early for PSG Photograph: Adam Vaughan/EPA Share Updated at  16.17 EDT 1h ago 16.10 EDT 10 min : Knaak has an overhit but it’s no surprise with this the German international’s first game in four months.
 Share 1h ago 16.09 EDT 9 min : Greenwood is over the ball to take the set piece and the delivery is good, it goes beyond Peda but no City player can take advantage.
 Share 1h ago 16.08 EDT 8 min : City’s tight press has been impressive so far. PSG have little time on the ball going forward and it has meant they have had no touches in the box. Hemp now has a good run and she wins a free kick in a good position.
 Share 1h ago 16.06 EDT 6 min : City are definitely the brighter in these early stages, they have time to create a clinical chance but so far they are lacking that final touch.
 Share 1h ago 16.04 EDT 4 min : City have the first real chance as they try and find Shaw in the box but Karchaoui marshals the threat well. The hosts come again with Fujino finding the Jamaica international but she can’t connect with the cross.
 Share 1h ago 16.02 EDT 2 min : Can you believe this is the first time these two clubs have met? That fun fact blew my mind a bit. Both teams starting slowly, trying to figure the other out.
 Share 1h ago 16.01 EDT Kick-off!
 Here we go , the action is underway in Manchester.
 Share 2h ago 15.49 EDT So the Celebrity Traitors is on tonight in the UK and I know the show is popular all over the world but who would you say is the ultimate women’s football traitor? Let me know be emailing me.
 Share 2h ago 15.40 EDT Two Women’s Champions League games have already taken place today and here are the results:
 Paris FC 1-1 Hacken
 Austria Wien 1-4 Juventus

 Manchester City have made three changes from their draw against Manchester United last weekend, most significantly Grace Clinton starts.
 Man City : Yamashita, Casparij, Rose, Knaak, Greenwood, Blindkilde Brown, Hasegawa, Fujino, Clinton, Hemp, Shaw
 Bench: Cumings, Moorhouse, Fowler, Charles, Lohmann, Beney, Prior, Wamser, Lewis, Burdon 
 View image in fullscreen Photograph: Clare Overfield/SPP/Shutterstock PSG, meanwhile, make five changes from their loss against Lyon last weekend with a change of goalkeeper with Oliwia Peda between the sticks this evening.
 PSG : Peda; Chagas, Mbock, Samoura, Carmona; Morissaint, Osteras, Groenen, Karchaoui, Feller, Echegini.
 Bench: Groothoff, Toussaint, Vitória Yaya, Jourde, Kanjinga, Elimbi Gilbert, Le Roux, Le Guilly, Lafontaine. 
 Share 2h ago 15.00 EDT Preamble
 Hello and welcome to this Women’s Champions League clash between Manchester City and Paris Saint-Germain. The English club are searching for their first win of the European campaign after two draws, while the French club will be aiming to build on their winning momentum.
 PSG drew 1-1 with Real Madrid in their opening game but they beat OH Leuven 5-1 last time out, while Man City have drawn against Real Madrid and Bayern Munich so far.
 Not much separates the two clubs in terms of domestic form either with both in second in the table of their respective leagues. This is marked out to be a close encounter but City will have the slight edge as they are at home.
 The team news will be announced shortly so stay tuned for that before kick-off at 8pm GMT.
